title: Cape Canaveral as cover for non-space projects
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: If you put project X on Cape Canaveral Air Force Station they can always say oh well it's just related to the space program.

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he worked with NASA, the US space agency, and saw an odd craft in a secret hangar, says that Cape Canaveral, a US Air Force launch site in Florida, made a good hiding place for projects that had nothing to do with space. According to Rogers, if you put some secret project there, officials could always say it was just part of the space programme. He tells it to explain how secret work could hide in plain sight.
